questions.q:
Read the below statements marked as Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Mark the correct options:

Assertion (A) : The One Nation One Ration Card ensures portability of food grains.

Reason (R) : It uses Aadhaar-enabled biometric authentication.
o: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
questions.s:
The correct answer is Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.

Key Points

  • The One Nation One Ration Card (ONORC) scheme ensures the portability of food grains under the National Food Security Act (NFSA).
  • Portability allows eligible beneficiaries to access their entitled food grains from any Fair Price Shop (FPS) in India, irrespective of their location.
  • It particularly benefits migrant workers and their families who relocate to different states or regions for work or other reasons.
  • The scheme uses Aadhaar-enabled biometric authentication to verify the identity of beneficiaries at FPS outlets. This ensures that food grains are delivered to the rightful beneficiaries.
  • The integration of Aadhaar with the Public Distribution System (PDS) helps in preventing leakages, duplication, and fraud in the system.
  • ONORC was introduced to support the vision of a unified India and address food security challenges faced by the migrant population.

Additional Information

  • A is true, but R is false
    • This option is incorrect because Reason (R) is true. The Aadhaar-enabled biometric authentication plays a crucial role in ensuring portability under the scheme.
  • A is false, but R is true
    • This option is incorrect because Assertion (A) is correct. The One Nation One Ration Card indeed ensures portability of food grains.
  • Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
    • This option is incorrect because Reason (R) directly supports Assertion (A). The Aadhaar-enabled system is a core component of ensuring portability.

If the formula for converting degrees Fahrenheit to degrees Celsius is C = $\frac{5}{9}$ (F - 32), what is the value of F when C is 30?
questions.s:
Given

the Celsius temperature is 30

Formula used 

 C = $\frac{5}{9}$ (F - 32)

Calculation

Rearranging the given the equation

$F=\frac{9C}{5}+32$

    = $\frac{9\times 30}{5}+32=86$

The value of F is 86

questions.q:
If P @ Q means that P is mother-in-law of Q, P % Q means that P is mother of Q, P * Q means P is the daughter of Q and P $ Q means that P is the son of Q, then which of the following expression shows that A is the granddaughter of G?

यदि P @ Q का अर्थ है कि P, Q की सास है, P % Q का अर्थ है कि P, Q की माँ है, P * Q का अर्थ है P, Q की पुत्री है और P $ Q का अर्थ है कि P, Q का पुत्र है, तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा व्यंजक दर्शाता है कि A, G की पोती/नातिन है?
o: A @ D $ F $ GA @ D $ F $ G
A * R $ GA * R $ G
A % S @ GA % S @ G
A * J % GA * J % G
questions.s:
It is given that,

P @ Q means that P is mother-in-law of Q,

P % Q means that P is mother of Q,

P * Q means P is the daughter of Q,

P $ Q means that P is the son of Q.

Option (a) A @ D $ F $ G

A is the mother-in-law of D. D is the son of F and F is the son of G.

Here, A is not the granddaughter of G.

Option (b) A * R $ G

A is the daughter of R and R is the son of G.

Here, A is the granddaughter of G.

Option (c) A % S @ G

A is the mother of S and S is the mother-in-law of G.

Here, A is not the granddaughter of G.

Option (d) A * J % G

A is the daughter of J and J is the mother of G.

Here, A is not the granddaughter of G.

questions_hin.q_hi:
If P @ Q means that P is mother-in-law of Q, P % Q means that P is mother of Q, P * Q means P is the daughter of Q and P $ Q means that P is the son of Q, then which of the following expression shows that A is the granddaughter of G?

यदि P @ Q का अर्थ है कि P, Q की सास है, P % Q का अर्थ है कि P, Q की माँ है, P * Q का अर्थ है P, Q की पुत्री है और P $ Q का अर्थ है कि P, Q का पुत्र है, तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा व्यंजक दर्शाता है कि A, G की पोती/नातिन है?
o_hi: A @ D $ F $ GA @ D $ F $ G
A * R $ GA * R $ G
A % S @ GA % S @ G
A * J % GA * J % G
questions_hin.s_hi:
It is given that,

P @ Q means that P is mother-in-law of Q,

P % Q means that P is mother of Q,

P * Q means P is the daughter of Q,

P $ Q means that P is the son of Q.

Option (a) A @ D $ F $ G

A is the mother-in-law of D. D is the son of F and F is the son of G.

Here, A is not the granddaughter of G.

Option (b) A * R $ G

A is the daughter of R and R is the son of G.

Here, A is the granddaughter of G.

Option (c) A % S @ G

A is the mother of S and S is the mother-in-law of G.

Here, A is not the granddaughter of G.

Option (d) A * J % G

A is the daughter of J and J is the mother of G.

Here, A is not the granddaughter of G.
